I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread. I noted her correction: the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 24 September, not the date she posted in #north-team. A deadline date is an operational fact, not a money figure, so it was fine to repeat in that channel.

I also pointed out two things:
- **The date has already passed:** 24 September is three weeks before today (14 October). Either that deadline has been missed, or she's reading the wrong line again, so I asked her to confirm.
- **#north-team still shows the wrong date:** I didn't change anything there, because she said no action was needed.
